eldeth.line: A word, if you've a moment.

ront.line: You. Keep away from my corner.

jimjar.line: Care to make it interesting? I'll give you odds.

buppido.line: Such interesting hands you have. Come, sit with me.

sarith.line: Don't look at me like that. I had my reasons.

derendil.line: You stand before a prince. Act accordingly.

topsy.line: Shh. The guards listen. Come closer.

turvy.line: You're new. New ones get eaten first.

shuushar.line: Peace, friend. Violence is a cage of its own.

stool.voice: the listener's own (characters.voice_id); rapport spores, lib/rapport.ts

jorlan.line: Go. Quickly, before the next watch.
